subtopics.title: Pre-training
subtopics.summary: The initial phase where a model is trained on massive unlabeled text corpora to learn general language patterns and knowledge, typically optimized for text completion rather than conversation.

subtopics.title: Supervised Finetuning (SFT)
subtopics.summary: The process of training a pre-trained model on labeled instruction-response pairs to align it with conversational behavior and task-specific outputs.

subtopics.title: Preference Finetuning
subtopics.summary: The alignment stage that uses human feedback to rank model outputs and optimize the model to generate responses that match human preferences.

subtopics.title: Training Design Decisions
subtopics.summary: Key architectural and hyperparameter choices made during foundation model training that have consequential impact on downstream applications and model capabilities.
